# DeckyHub

> DeckyHub is a free, open-source plugin store for the Steam Deck. It is a Decky Loader plugin that lets you find, install and update 500+ Decky Loader plugins from Gaming Mode with your controller, including plugins that aren't on the official Decky Loader store, and any other Decky plugin on GitHub.

DeckyHub runs inside Decky Loader on SteamOS (Steam Deck and other SteamOS devices). It lists the plugins in the DeckyHub registry (https://registry.deckyhub.com/), checks your installed plugins for new releases, and installs or updates them through Decky Loader's own installer, which asks you to confirm first. It never installs anything without a tap. It's made by mazillka and licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. Most of its code was written with AI tools (Claude and Codex), and every release is tested on a real Steam Deck.

## Key facts

- What it is: a Decky Loader plugin (a "plugin store" or "plugin hub") for Steam Deck.
- Price: free. Source: https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin
- Requires: a Steam Deck or other SteamOS device with Decky Loader 3.x, and internet access to GitHub. No GitHub account needed.
- Plugin list: 500+ plugins in the DeckyHub registry, by category (frame generation, game libraries, controllers, performance, themes, utilities and more), each with downloads, GitHub stars and last release date.
- Safety information per plugin: a ClamAV and YARA virus scan of the exact release ZIP, warnings from Decky Extended Plugins' security audit, a "Runs as root" badge, and an "AI" badge for plugins developed with AI coding assistants. DeckyHub doesn't review or endorse plugins; they install at your own risk.
- Updates: checks installed plugins every few hours, shows what each update brings, and updates DeckyHub itself from its Quick Access tab. Stable or pre-release channel per plugin.
- Not affiliated with Valve or the Decky Loader project.

## Install

- Easiest, from Desktop Mode: download https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases/latest/download/Install-DeckyHub.desktop, double-click it, choose Execute, read the overview of the steps and enter your Deck's admin password (needed because installing and restarting Decky Loader change the system). It checks Decky Loader first and installs it with Decky's official installer if it's missing, then installs DeckyHub. It collects, saves and sends no information. It can also show a few optional plugins one at a time (Skip is the default), which DeckyHub installs after you confirm.
- From Gaming Mode, with Decky Loader installed: Decky settings > General > Developer mode on, then Developer > Install Plugin from URL with https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases/latest/download/DeckyHub.zip
- Or download the latest DeckyHub-vX.Y.Z.zip from https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/releases and use Decky's Developer > Install Plugin from ZIP.

## Pages

- [DeckyHub home](https://deckyhub.com/): features, screenshots, install guide and FAQ
- [DeckyHub home in Ukrainian](https://deckyhub.com/uk/): the same page in Ukrainian (українською)
- [Release notes](https://deckyhub.com/releases.html): what's new in each version
- [Help](https://deckyhub.com/help.html): installing, updates, badges, virus scans and troubleshooting, as questions and answers
- [About](https://deckyhub.com/about.html): who makes DeckyHub, where its plugin list comes from, and how it's built and tested
- [Full documentation](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin#readme): every screen, settings, troubleshooting, privacy
- [Plugin catalog](https://registry.deckyhub.com/): every plugin DeckyHub lists, with descriptions, stats and safety badges
- [Plugin catalog for AI](https://registry.deckyhub.com/llms.txt): the plugin list as plain text
- [Registry editor](https://registry.deckyhub.com/editor.html): build your own plugin list for DeckyHub
- [Report an issue](https://github.com/mazillka/deckyhub-plugin/issues)
